description: The agent executes the missing test cases one by one after the first feedback and rewrites the report each time: 3 → 2 → 1 missing rows → complete. Only the first failure uses a retry; the shrinking ones are progress (feedback, no retry), so the loop never runs out of retries while work is being done. The reviewer runs once, on the complete report.

| TC-REQ-14b.1 | Added on the details page → 'Remove' on the inventory page | PASS | PASS | — |
